label: sec:h2-computation-intro
html: We turn to the smallest covalent molecule. The hydrogen molecule H_2 as a braid in H_4(q) places two protons and two electrons on four strands and lets them share a single trefoil. The LP dual selects the optimal H_2 binding, determines the bond order, and provides the binding energy. We compare the predicted H_2 binding energy with the spectroscopic value. The covalent channel eigenvalue ratio yields the equilibrium internuclear separation. This sets the template for the heteronuclear and polyatomic cases.
